resources.string: This phone has no voice dictation. Turn on or install the Google voice service.
To dictate, Cuentiva uses the microphone only while you speak. The app does not save any audio.
Allow the microphone to dictate. You can also type with the keyboard.
The microphone is blocked for Cuentiva. Turn it on in Settings → Permissions, or type with the keyboard.
This phone has no voice dictation. Use the keyboard microphone (Gboard) or install/enable the Google app.
No internet: download the offline language in Settings → Google → Voice.
I didn\'t hear you, try again.
Dictation is busy. Wait a moment and try again.
The voice service failed. Try again or use the keyboard microphone.
Your phone can\'t dictate in this language. Go to Settings → Language & input → Voice → Offline languages and download English, or use the keyboard microphone (Gboard).
Could not use the microphone. Check that no other app is using it and try again.
Something went wrong with dictation. Try again or use the keyboard microphone (Gboard).
